meta.title: 用慢快门&慢动作！让VLOG打开新世界的大门
meta.title_en: Slow Shutter & Slow Motion: Open a New World for Your Vlog

scenes.title_cn: 慢速快门原理：你肯定在电影中看到过这…
scenes.title_en: Slow shutter principle: you've surely seen…
scenes.context: 慢快门记录运动轨迹产生拖影。
sentences: 场景中运动的部分带有明显的拖影，随之而来的是慌乱和迷离的观感。
Moving parts carry obvious trails, bringing a chaotic, dreamy feel.
motion trails（拖影）
快门速度可以理解为相机快门开合一次的时间，在这个时间内相机会记录下画面中物体的运动轨迹。
Shutter speed is the opening time per shot, recording the object's motion trail.
motion trail（运动轨迹）
15分之一秒足够动一段距离了，所以画面里能看到美妙的拖影。
1/15s is enough to travel a distance, so you see a lovely trail.
lovely trail（美妙拖影）
scenes.speak: Moving parts carry obvious trails, bringing a chaotic, dreamy feel. Shutter speed is the opening time per shot, recording the object's motion trail. 1/15s is enough to travel a distance, so you see a lovely trail.

scenes.title_cn: 静态主体的玩法：当快门速度的分母小于…
scenes.title_en: Static-subject play: when the shutter deno…
scenes.context: 三脚架固定，主体静止，人流拖影。
sentences: 当快门速度的分母小于拍摄帧率时，就会产生像电影中那样的拖影和抽帧的效果。
When the shutter denominator is below the frame rate, you get trails and stutter.
below frame rate（低于帧率）
让需要被看清的物体保持相对静止，比如架好三脚架，然后站在人流之中。
Keep the subject still—set up a tripod and stand in the crowd.
tripod still（三脚架静止）
如果你的Vlog需要展现孤独感，这样的画面会非常实用。
If your vlog needs loneliness, such shots are very practical.
show loneliness（展现孤独）
scenes.speak: When the shutter denominator is below the frame rate, you get trails and stutter. Keep the subject still—set up a tripod and stand in the crowd. If your vlog needs loneliness, such shots are very practical.

scenes.title_cn: 镜头运动的玩法：当然也可以让镜头运动…
scenes.title_en: Camera-motion play: of course, you can als…
scenes.context: 镜头绕主体旋转，配合参考线固定主体。
sentences: 也可以让镜头运动起来，比如侧着跟或者绕着人旋转。
You can also move the lens—track from the side or orbit around a person.
orbit the subject（绕着旋转）
借助相机的参考线，让主体保持在画面的固定位置。
Use the grid lines to keep the subject at a fixed spot.
grid lines（参考线）
当你想在Vlog里营造一些怪力怪气的感觉，都可以试试把快门速度调慢。
For a weird, otherworldly vibe, try lowering the shutter speed.
weird vibe（怪力怪气）
scenes.speak: You can also move the lens—track from the side or orbit around a person. Use the grid lines to keep the subject at a fixed spot. For a weird, otherworldly vibe, try lowering the shutter speed.

scenes.title_cn: 慢动作原理：同样与慢相关，慢动作画面…
scenes.context: 高帧率低帧率播放，细节捕捉。
sentences: 这种手法说白了就是高帧数画面用低帧数播放。
It's high-frame-rate footage played back at a low frame rate.
high fps, low playback（高拍低放）
30帧拍60帧，就可以得到0.5倍的慢动作，120帧就是0.25倍。
Shoot 60fps in a 30fps vlog for 0.5x; 120fps gives 0.25x.
0.5x and 0.25x
体现一些细微的动作会是一种不错的选择。
Showing subtle movements is a nice choice.
subtle movements（细微动作）
scenes.speak: It's high-frame-rate footage played back at a low frame rate. Shoot 60fps in a 30fps vlog for 0.5x; 120fps gives 0.25x. Showing subtle movements is a nice choice.

scenes.title_cn: 慢动作放大情绪：当然慢动作又有放大情…
scenes.title_en: Slow motion amplifies emotion: slow motion…
scenes.context: 慢动作放大情绪，像一句台词的回响。
sentences: 慢动作又有放大情绪、修饰演技的作用。
Slow motion magnifies emotion and polishes acting.
magnify emotion（放大情绪）
现在这段画面用常速播放就会显得我很蠢。
This segment at normal speed would make me look silly.
normal speed silly（常速显蠢）
生命不过是一次闪电。
Life is but a lightning flash.
a lightning flash（一次闪电）
scenes.speak: Slow motion magnifies emotion and polishes acting. This segment at normal speed would make me look silly. Life is but a lightning flash.

practice: Long shutter records motion trails in one frame.
Tripod still, crowd flows into trails.
Orbit the subject with grid lines holding center.
High fps captured, low fps playback.
Slow motion magnifies emotion and details.
pitfalls: Shoot at normal shutter for emotion shots.
Low the shutter to create trails and stutter.
Let the whole frame blur chaotically.
Keep the subject still with a tripod.
三脚架让主体保持静止。
Use grid lines to hold the subject center.
环绕拍摄借助参考线固定。
Shoot slow motion at the same frame rate.
Capture high fps and play back low.
Use slow motion for complex fights.
Use it to show subtle, telling details.
慢动作拍细微动作更有戏。
shifts: 用 motion trails（拖影）、slow shutter（慢门）、below frame rate（低于帧率）
说慢动作只会说 slow motion
用 high fps low playback（高拍低放）、subtle movements（细微动作）、magnify emotion（放大情绪）
用 tripod still（三脚架静止）、grid lines（参考线）、orbit the subject（绕主体旋转）
